They are also an [[Enemy Weapon]] that can be wielded by [[Link]], as well as other [[Enemy|Enemies]] like [[Bokoblin]]s and [[Darknut]]s. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 4 |durability = 15 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Moblin Spear}} Moblin Spears are wooden [[Weapon]]s carried by regular [[Moblin]]s, particularly in the [[Faron Grasslands]] and [[Gerudo Highlands]]. They are roughly fashioned and created from whittling [[Tree]]s, and they therefore have both low [[Durability]] and little strength. They belong to the [[Moblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by Moblins. Being made of wood, Moblin Spears will float if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, they will also burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they are unable to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName =
